svg.title: Black Panel with White Curve I
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry, interpretive colours. Rectangular black panel and adjoining white half-ellipse preserved; arc control points approximate. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of black, white; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.sfmoma.org/artwork/FC.351/; reviewed 2026-10-27; not a facsimile.
